# Crafty 4.11.0 contract fixtures

Captured on 2026-10-08 from the official Linux ARM64 image with Paper 1.21.1 and a
full-access superuser key. IDs, paths and timestamps are normalized; no credentials
are included. Response shapes match the previous baseline. `spec-summary.json`
records the unchanged official OpenAPI snapshot. See [the API contract](../../../../docs/api-contract.md).
